verdicts.evidence: A synthetic geometry check recovered latent trajectories with max error 6.90e-06 and reprojection error 3.74e-06, passing a 1e-4 threshold, but this was on synthetic data and the package cannot import due to missing lvcg.data modules.

The logbook confirms the paper describes three loss terms, but finds the released code adds a unit-weight base-beat loss absent from Equation 7, required a post-paper GRU shape fix, and cannot import to run any training.

Only arithmetic consistency of Table 1 averages (calculated 67.30 vs printed 67.3) and split disjointness were checked; no checkpoints, training, or evaluation was executed, and PTB-XL Sub-Class label ordering differs between splits.
The repository contains zero checkpoints, reconstruction predictions, per-lead outputs, or metric files; Table 2 cannot be regenerated and no reconstruction experiment was run.
No ablation configs, checkpoints, seeds, or outputs are released; the ablation tables are display-only with no executed experiments behind them.
The paper evaluates MIMIC-IV-ECG-Ext-ICD but the repository supplies an AI-READI provider instead, with no paper-dataset loader, folds, labels, checkpoint, or outputs; no experiment was run.

overall: The logbook establishes that the VCG linear-projection geometry is numerically sound on synthetic data and that released data splits are disjoint, but the Python package cannot import due to missing modules and no empirical results from Tables 1–5 can be reproduced because no checkpoints or output artifacts are released.
